metaDescription: Get in touch with Lili David — facilitator, consultant, and coach.

hero.headline: Get in touch
hero.lead: If you're trying to build a way of working that is both effective and human, I'd be glad to hear more about your context. There's no obligation — an initial conversation is simply a chance to understand each other's situations.

form.title: Send a message
form.note: I aim to respond to all messages within two working days. If your situation is time-sensitive, please mention it in your message.
form.thankYou: Thank you. Your message has been sent. I'll get back to you as soon as I can.
form.privacyNote: Your information will be used only to respond to your enquiry. See the Privacy Policy for details.

schedule.title: Schedule a conversation
schedule.body: Prefer to find a time directly? You can book a 45 minute exploratory call using the scheduler below.

linkedin.title: Connect on LinkedIn
linkedin.body: I'm quite active on LinkedIn and regularly share reflections and practical insights from my work with teams and organisations.
